observed_behavior: When process_payment() is called twice with the same operation_id, both calls succeed and two distinct rows are inserted into the ledger. A client retry — submitting the same logical payment operation a second time after a timeout — is treated as a brand-new operation. The ledger therefore records two charges for one logical payment event.
expected_invariant: One logical payment operation, uniquely identified by its operation_id, must produce exactly one durable ledger entry regardless of how many times it is submitted. Resubmitting the same operation_id must not create a second row; the second call must be deduplicated and must return without writing to the ledger.

real_demo_run_output.note: Two rows with identical operation_id. Defect observed directly.

evidence_refs.summary: process_payment() performs a bare INSERT with no prior lookup for existing operation_id. No UNIQUE constraint on ledger.operation_id. A repeat call with the same operation_id reaches the INSERT path unconditionally.
